page: Google Cloud Platform c4d-highmem-48-lssd is a member of the c4d server family, featuring 48 dedicated vCPUs built on the x86_64 CPU architecture. The instance is configured with 378.0 GB of system memory, providing approximately 7.88 GB of RAM per core. This high memory-to-vCPU ratio supports memory-intensive operations without requiring excessive compute scaling.

This server configuration includes integrated local storage consisting of four NVMe SSDs, totaling 1611 GB of local storage capacity. The local NVMe SSDs are bundled directly with the instance, offering high-speed, low-latency local data access. The instance does not include any complimentary public IPv4 addresses, and it does not feature any GPU hardware accelerators.

Given the dedicated CPU allocation, substantial memory capacity, and integrated local NVMe SSD storage, this server type is designed for resource-dense workloads. The hardware profile is suited for memory-intensive databases, large-scale caching layers, data analytics, and transactional databases that require fast local scratch space.
